verdicts_or_reports.screen: Card template editor (Cloze) - toolbar More options menu
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The template editor toolbar menu is built the same way for every note model, so the Cloze menu should list the same per-type entries Basic shows, including "Rename card type" and "Deck override (off)".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Cloze menu shows 5 entries: Add card type, Browser appearance, Insert field, Copy as Markdown, Restore to default. It has no "Rename card type" and no "Deck override (off)". Basic's menu (also one template) shows Rename card type and Deck override (off) alongside the same entries.
steps: From the deck list, open the navigation drawer and tap Card browser, or open More options > Manage note types.
Open More options (top right) > Manage note types.
Tap Edit cards on the Cloze row (count 0 notes).
Tap More options (top right) in the Card types screen. Note the entries: Add card type, Browser appearance, Insert field, Copy as Markdown, Restore to default.
Go back, tap More actions on the Basic row, which has one template, and then Edit cards. Tap More options. Note Rename card type and Deck override (off) are listed.

harness_replies: Developer: could not reproduce with the steps given.

sign_off.notes: Coverage: Add note card preview for Basic (Card 1), Basic (and reversed card) (Card 1 and 2, switching back and forth), Cloze (Card 1 and 2 with cloze text), and Basic (optional reversed card) with an empty conditional card 2 ("The front of this card is blank.") and then filled in (Card 2 updates to "hi"). Template editor toolbar menu checked on Basic, Basic (and reversed card) and Cloze; the one difference I noticed (Cloze lacks Rename card type / Deck override) was reported and the developer could not reproduce it, so I dropped it. Deck list: created a temporary parent with a child to exercise the expander; expand and collapse worked, rows below kept correct counts, state survived rotation, and I deleted the temporary decks afterwards. Manage note types counts matched the data (Basic 8 notes after my test note; other types 0). Side effects to be aware of: while testing I accidentally saved one Basic note (Front "cat", empty Back) into the Default deck; it is still there and was not removed. Not covered: decks with cards in child decks, Image Occlusion preview, multi-template types with 3+ templates (none in this build).
